metadata.description: Comprehensive slang feature data for steering experiments

usage_guide.universal_3_langs: Use for experiments targeting ALL languages simultaneously
usage_guide.exclusive_pairs: Use for experiments targeting exactly 2 languages (feature is NOT discriminative in third)
usage_guide.language_specific: Use for experiments targeting only ONE language
usage_guide.union_sets: Use for experiments that should affect AT LEAST the specified languages
usage_guide.intersection_sets: Validated features appearing in multiple analyses

universal_all_three.description: Features discriminative for slang in ALL 3 languages (English, Hebrew, Russian)
universal_all_three.use_case: Steering that should affect slang detection across all languages

Hebrew_Russian_not_English.description: Features discriminative in Hebrew AND Russian, but NOT in English
Hebrew_Russian_not_English.use_case: Steering that should affect Hebrew and Russian but NOT English

Hebrew_English_not_Russian.description: Features discriminative in Hebrew AND English, but NOT in Russian
Hebrew_English_not_Russian.use_case: Steering that should affect Hebrew and English but NOT Russian

English_Russian_not_Hebrew.description: Features discriminative in English AND Russian, but NOT in Hebrew
English_Russian_not_Hebrew.use_case: Steering that should affect English and Russian but NOT Hebrew

English_only.description: Features discriminative ONLY in English (not in Hebrew or Russian top-100)
English_only.use_case: Steering that should affect ONLY English slang detection

Hebrew_only.description: Features discriminative ONLY in Hebrew (not in English or Russian top-100)
Hebrew_only.use_case: Steering that should affect ONLY Hebrew slang detection

Russian_only.description: Features discriminative ONLY in Russian (not in English or Hebrew top-100)
Russian_only.use_case: Steering that should affect ONLY Russian slang detection

union_sets.description: Features that are discriminative in AT LEAST the specified languages (may also work in others)

English_or_Hebrew_or_Russian.description: ALL features in top-100 for ANY language (full feature pool)

English_or_Hebrew.description: Features in top-100 for English OR Hebrew (may or may not be in Russian)
English_or_Hebrew.use_case: Steering targeting English and Hebrew speakers

English_or_Russian.description: Features in top-100 for English OR Russian (may or may not be in Hebrew)
English_or_Russian.use_case: Steering targeting English and Russian speakers

Hebrew_or_Russian.description: Features in top-100 for Hebrew OR Russian (may or may not be in English)
Hebrew_or_Russian.use_case: Steering targeting Hebrew and Russian speakers

intersection_sets.description: Features appearing in multiple languages (simple overlap, not exclusive)

English_and_Hebrew.description: Features in top-100 for BOTH English AND Hebrew (regardless of Russian)

English_and_Russian.description: Features in top-100 for BOTH English AND Russian (regardless of Hebrew)

Hebrew_and_Russian.description: Features in top-100 for BOTH Hebrew AND Russian (regardless of English)

validated_features.description: Features that passed multiple validation criteria

final_recommended.description: Final recommended features from intersection analysis

best_by_strength.description: Features with high coverage AND high discrimination strength

cross_validated.description: Features appearing in both intersection AND metric-based analyses

high_coverage_50pct.description: Features appearing in >50% of analyzed terms

top_precision.description: Features with highest precision (when they fire, it is slang)

top_recall.description: Features with highest recall (catch most slang)

top_f1.description: Features with best F1 score (balanced precision/recall)

top_specificity.description: Features with highest specificity (ignore literal usage)

tier_1_universal_3_langs.description: Features in top-100 for all 3 languages

tier_2_partial_2_langs.description: Features in top-100 for exactly 2 languages

tier_3_specific_1_lang.description: Features in top-100 for exactly 1 language

for_all_languages.description: Recommended features for steering ALL languages

for_english_only.description: Recommended features for steering ONLY English
for_english_only.note: Use language-specific features to minimize cross-linguistic effects

for_hebrew_only.description: Recommended features for steering ONLY Hebrew
for_hebrew_only.note: Use language-specific features to minimize cross-linguistic effects

for_russian_only.description: Recommended features for steering ONLY Russian
for_russian_only.note: Use language-specific features to minimize cross-linguistic effects

for_hebrew_and_russian_not_english.description: Steering Hebrew and Russian WITHOUT affecting English
for_hebrew_and_russian_not_english.note: These features are explicitly NOT discriminative in English

for_hebrew_and_english_not_russian.description: Steering Hebrew and English WITHOUT affecting Russian
for_hebrew_and_english_not_russian.note: These features are explicitly NOT discriminative in Russian

for_english_and_russian_not_hebrew.description: Steering English and Russian WITHOUT affecting Hebrew
for_english_and_russian_not_hebrew.note: These features are explicitly NOT discriminative in Hebrew
